name: Dirty Crown Scandal
source:
"You are the Emperor's only son."

Matias, who was living an ordinary but happy life, suddenly enters the palace due to his status as a prince...

"As long as you're here, you're fated to be devoured."

[From [url=https://apps.apple.com/us/app/dirty-crown-fantasy-story/id6450760298]App Store[/url]]
translation:
“你是皇帝唯一的儿子。”

原本过着平凡却幸福生活的马蒂亚斯，突然因王子身份进入皇宫……

“只要你在这里，就注定会被吞噬。”

[来自[url=https://apps.apple.com/us/app/dirty-crown-fantasy-story/id6450760298]App Store[/url]]
